case_title: LAWRENCE M. DAVIS VS. VIMO, INC.

docket_entries.description: DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT VIMO, INC.
APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT. NO EXHIBITS DETAINED BY THE COURT. MATTER WAS TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF 02-04-13 BY JUDGE DON MITCHELL. CLERK: S. RAVINANTAPRICHA, NOT REPORTED.
